title.narrative: Buka Electricity Grid Solar Upgrade in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: Papua New Guinea (PNG) has a large economy; however, electricity access is low with 21% of the population having grid-electricity access in 2021. The Buka grid is currently fully diesel dependent, and therefore, the Buka Electricity Grid Solar Upgrade, aims to strengthen energy access for the Buka population through providing practical solar PV energy systems and upgrading the distribution systems, thereby enhancing the access to basic services\nand fostering economic development. The proposed project is expected to reduce reliance on expensive diesel generation by 90% and significantly improve the reliability and resilience of the Buka Island electrical grid by meeting the existing and anticipated ten-year future demand.\n
